Backend: 15/15 pytest passed against the live preview URL. Delivery settings persist. Protected routes (/wishlist, /orders, /profile/addresses, /profile/edit) correctly redirect to /login; /notifications page shows login-required state. Admin URL is /portal-7x9k2m4p8q3z6n1v (not /admin-secret-x9k3p as stated in the request — already configured this way in /app/frontend/src/lib/admin-path.js).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin path mismatch with spec — code uses '/portal-7x9k2m4p8q3z6n1v' but the review request says '/admin-secret-x9k3p'. Decide which one is canonical and update either /app/frontend/src/lib/admin-path.js or the spec/test_credentials.md.
server.py is now 1366 lines — split into routers (orders/settings/admin/auth) for maintainability (carry-over).

POST /api/orders for guests does not require any phone format validation — a 4-character non-empty phone is accepted. Consider validating Bangladeshi phone format (e.g. /^01[3-9]\d{8}$/) to keep tracking reliable.

/api/orders/track uses last-6-digit fuzzy match — fine for UX but means anyone who guesses an order number and tries common 6-digit suffixes could enumerate orders. Acceptable for demo; flag for production hardening (consider stricter match or rate-limit on /track).
GET /api/orders/track with empty phone returns 422 (Pydantic) rather than the spec's 'Phone is required' 400 because phone is a required query param. Cosmetic.

Signup page button reads 'অ্যাকাউন্ট তৈরি করুন' (Create account) instead of literal 'সাইনআপ' — semantically equivalent and acceptable, but the spec listed 'সাইনআপ' as expected text. Just a heads-up if strict text matching is needed.
